def decimal_to_Octal(deciNum):
    """Write a python function to convert decimal number to octal number."""
    if deciNum == 0:
        return 0
    negative = deciNum < 0
    deciNum = abs(deciNum)
    octal = 0
    place = 1
    while deciNum > 0:
        octal += (deciNum % 8) * place
        deciNum //= 8
        place *= 10
    return -octal if negative else octal
